I am a student and I took an education loan from YES BANK for my master studies abroad from their Mumbai branch. What started with trust and hope for my future turned into 1.5 years of stress, financial pressure, mental harassment, and complete disappointment.

Terms and conditions, hidden charges, and important policies were never clearly communicated to me as a student already under pressure of university deadlines.

The biggest shock came when after months of delay from the bank side, the loan amount was finally disbursed  3 days after my university fee deadline had already passed. Even after informing the officer multiple times about the urgency and deadlines, the bank kept delaying while continuously collecting documents. The amount was disbursed after the intake opportunity was already ruined.

The most shocking part is that the bank demanded huge interest payments despite the fact that I never even used a single penny from the disbursed amount for my studies. On top of that lakhs were already deducted in the name of processing fees, insurance, and hidden charges that were never properly explained during the process.

The complaint system, nodal officers, and even RBI escalation process felt useless for a common person because responses take months and mostly protect the bank internally instead of investigating the truth fairly. No action is taken against officers who misguide students and ruin careers. Seniors like Santosh Pandey only pressured me to close the loan instead of resolving the actual issue.

Because of this entire situation, my career plans, future studies, mental health, and even my family suffered badly. Students take education loans with trust and hope for their future, not to get trapped in hidden conditions, delays, frozen funds, pressure tactics, and one sided allegations.
